summary: Merged first-property plan for Green Alpha Property Management. The strongest decisions are role-based access and accounting segregation, trackable vanity/SMS numbers, live availability with preleasing controls, 12-month conventional leasing at Millbend Phase II, in-person affordable intake with Entrata-generated documents, balance transfers, structured make-ready and maintenance workflows, and month-to-month charges for newly notified residents. Later calls supersede the earlier assumption of centralized affordable certification approval: that approval gate should remain off. Unsettled legal, accounting, renewal, transfer-screening, affordable-waitlist, and property-specific choices are listed as questions.
